releases.title: Live orchestration status board + build log
highlights: New internal /preview/status board — roadmap status (live / in-progress / waiting), the build queue, the enhancement backlog and a three-way reconcile watermark.

New /preview/releases build log (this page). Both read live box data files (roadmap.json / preview-releases.json) at request time via ROADMAP_DATA_PATH / RELEASES_DATA_PATH, so Winslow updates them with no redeploy.
Coexists with the existing product pages — the /preview product story, the customer /roadmap and /releases — which are unchanged.
releases.notes: The board reads a file mounted into the CYTWeb container; editing it on the box updates both pages instantly. Reconciled against GitHub main (CYTAPI f622f61 / CYTWeb 652d14f).

releases.title: API-key audit history + usage tracking (#3 C1 + C2)
highlights: #3 C1 — generation history: each minted bridge key records issuer · date · name · scope, with a history list that includes revoked and expired keys (GET /me/bridge-keys/history + a CYTWeb issuance-history panel).

#3 C2 — usage tracking: each authenticated bridge call bumps use_count + last_used_at in one atomic keyed update (failed / revoked / expired keys never count); settings shows 'Last used <when> · N uses'.
releases.notes: CYTAPI PR #31 (de4db13) + #32 (f622f61); CYTWeb PR #22 (4ec53e6) + #23 (652d14f). Additive migrations, backup-first, verified in-browser on prod. #3 C3 (per-use activity log) remains.

releases.title: Fine-grained module RBAC — complete (#5 C1+C2+C3)
highlights: Role hierarchy admin > support > licensee > collaborator, with collaborators bound to a specific topic/license and granted per-module access (topic_collaborators + User::hasModuleGrant()).
Licensee grant/revoke UI with a per-module checkbox grid, gated behind a 2FA step-up.
Enforcement gate — every module gated by (role + topic binding + module grant), fail-closed; the license ACL is managed by owner + admin.
releases.notes: CYTAPI PR #27–#30 (main 8467b2f), CYTWeb PR #21. Entitlement resolves through licensing; verified in-browser on prod (collaborator finance 200 / build,ads 403; owner full; stranger 404).

releases.title: Connectivity hub + platform association (#2 + #4)
highlights: Unified settings connectivity hub: multiple bridge/partner keys per consuming app plus AI-model provider keys (Claude · Grok · Gemini · OpenAI) with priority + default-model selection.
Every issued key/token is associated with a target platform picked from the integrations directory — 7 Empire products plus external QuickBooks/Zoho-style placeholders.
releases.notes: CYTWeb PR #20 (4accd3c), CYTAPI PR #26 (c60661f). All key issuance/reveal stays 2FA-gated (#1).

releases.title: 2FA-gated key reveal + Empire Bridge provider
highlights: 2FA step-up required to reveal or mint a plaintext cyt_qb_ bridge key.
Empire Integration Bridge provider surface live — topic + customer + Winslow-orchestration record providers (roadmap · next-steps · context · activity), connected & live into QuickerBiz.

releases.title: Multi-provider topic engine live
highlights: The multi-provider AI model ladder: OpenAI + Grok/xAI + Gemini, per-(user,provider) key + priority, cascade-on-exhaustion. Gemini gemini-3.x-flash live + free at the top of the ladder.
One line → a living app: a Winslow-style crew (9 specialists + orchestrator) researches, builds, markets and runs a topic, surfaced in living dashboards.
ops-MCP — run the agent crew on your own Claude subscription ($0) or a metered API key.
